title: Bliss D-201
subtitle: Where architecture serves the view, and design frames the infinite.
description:
The Curated Horizon
This refined residence redefines effortless indoor-outdoor living. Every corner has been meticulously styled with a carefully selected decor that looks as if it were lifted directly from the pages of a luxury design catalog. The apartment opens up to panoramic views of the winding swimming pools and manicured tropical gardens, allowing the vibrant colors of the exterior to act as a natural backdrop to an immaculate interior palette.

The Fluidity of Spaces
The living space is a testament to contemporary elegance, where custom warm wood cabinetry is beautifully balanced by organic textures and curated furniture pieces. The sleek, open-plan kitchen features a stylish granite countertop and breakfast bar, seamlessly integrating high-end stainless steel appliances into a layout designed for modern entertaining. This social heart of the condo flows naturally into the lounge, where full-length sliding glass walls dissolve the boundary between the interior and a generous private covered terrace.

An Oasis of Privacy
Both bedrooms serve as private retreats, masterfully configured to balance personal comfort with aesthetic rigor. The primary suite features a striking textured headboard, subtle accent lighting, and direct sliding door access to the terrace overlooking the water. The second bedroom offers great versatility with a dual-bed setup, beautifully anchored by custom live-edge headboards crafted from local solid hardwood. A soft sage accent wall perfectly complements the rich, warm grains of the regional wood, creating a serene and organic atmosphere.

The Lifestyle
Offered fully furnished, this 1,111 sq ft residence ensures a real estate transition with absolutely zero friction. Accessible via a building elevator from your assigned private parking space, this second-floor condo offers the ultimate luxury of a private exterior staircase leading directly from your balcony straight into the pool and garden areas. Living here means enjoying the ultra-secure, 24/7 gated environment of Puerto Aventuras, with immediate access to premium resort amenities and beaches. It is a rare opportunity to own a highly functional and turnkey asset in a prime coastal location.
